subject.title: [codex] Fix Anthropic Vertex npm audit regression

question: Should maintainers close/replace this stale local-client branch now that current main uses the official Vertex SDK 0.19.0 chain, or deliberately refresh it as a local auth-client replacement?
rationale: The choice changes auth-provider ownership and published provider dependencies, and the PR is protected, conflicting, and maintainer-uneditable, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent direction.

options.title: Prove Current Main And Close/Replace
options.body: Validate the current-main official SDK 0.19.0 provider path on Node 25+/26 with ADC, then close this branch or replace it with a narrow release follow-up if needed.

options.title: Refresh The Local Client
options.body: Rebase the branch and keep the local BaseAnthropic/GoogleAuth client only with explicit maintainer acceptance, provider dependency declarations, shrinkwrap regeneration, and live Vertex proof.

options.title: Wait For Release Triage
options.body: Leave the protected PR open until the related issue and next release decide whether current main is sufficient for affected users.

recommendation.title: Prove Current Main And Close/Replace
recommendation.body: Validate the current-main official SDK 0.19.0 provider path on Node 25+/26 with ADC, then close this branch or replace it with a narrow release follow-up if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has recent package-boundary/release involvement and initiated the ClawSweeper automerge path on this PR.
